committee: * Presentation for Legislative Certificate No. 348-38 (CORSenator Sabrina Salas Matanane) -
title: Hafa Adai, Join me in presenting Legislative Certificate No. 348-38 (COR) to the Micronesia Mall in recognition of its support of Guam’s cultural heritage. The Micronesia Mall is honored for hosting the Mes CHamoru Fiesta, a community event celebrating the island’s traditions, music, and identity. Through live performances, cultural activities, and family-friendly experiences, the mall provided a meaningful space to promote and preserve CHamoru culture.
